# OKazCar

> OKazCar is a free Chrome extension that analyses used car listings in real time. It cross-references 12 filters (mileage coherence, regional market price, engine reliability, recall status, import detection…) and returns a score out of 100, directly injected into the listing page — no account, no data collected.

OKazCar was created in 2024 during a Python training at Nüsanes Technologie in Geneva. It started as a scraping script and became a Chrome extension supporting 14 domains across 11 countries.

## Key facts

- Free, no account required, no personal data collected
- Runs entirely in the browser (no external server receives your browsing data)
- Score out of 100 based on 12 weighted filters (total weight: 16.0)
- Supported platforms: leboncoin.fr, lacentrale.fr, paruvendu.fr, autoscout24.fr, autoscout24.com,  autoscout24.de, autoscout24.ch, autoscout24.it, autoscout24.be, autoscout24.nl, autoscout24.at, autoscout24.es, autoscout24.pl, autoscout24.lu, autoscout24.se
- Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/okazcar

## The 12 filters

- L1: VIN / recall check (Takata airbag, NHTSA/RAPEX database)
- L2: Market price vs regional median (z-score, weight: 2.0)
- L3: Mileage coherence (km/year ratio vs statistical average of 13,000 km/year)
- L4: Price position in regional range (cascade: 30km → region → national, weight: 2.0)
- L5: Price coherence by engine power bracket (DIN hp range)
- L6: Seller phone indicator (foreign prefix detection)
- L7: Listing age vs category median
- L8: Import detection (cross-border vehicle flags)
- L9: Manufacturer recall status
- L10: Listing duration anomaly
- L11: Engine reliability database (12 motorisations flagged, e.g. BMW N47, PSA PureTech 1.2, VW EA189)
- L12: Engine reliability score (fiabilité moteur)

## Tech stack

- Chrome Extension (Manifest V3, JavaScript)
- Backend: Google Cloud Run
- Database: PostgreSQL (Neon)
- Landing page: React + Vite, deployed on Vercel
